policy_floor: manual resource cleanup in NEW C++ that is not RAII-wrapped (governance policy floor, 'documented impossibility' not self-granted; docs/cpp-conventions.md, routed-concern row 'C++ resource ownership and lifetime')
severity_native: policy floor (band if derived: I9/E5 INFO)
trigger: from_wide() throws bad_alloc between ConvertSidToStringSidW and the manual LocalFree(sid_str) in the new win_account_for_sid, leaking the OS-allocated string
classification_rationale: new C++ frees an OS-allocated string by hand after a call that can throw; docs/cpp-conventions.md forbids manual cleanup and the floor exception is not self-granted
summary: Policy floor; derived band alone would be LOW (I8, E5) but the floor gates regardless. code-review S-5 had deferred it LOW, which is not an adjudicated floor exception. Raised by security-guardian F5, cpp-safety, cpp-expert F1, architect F1 and cross-platform F3, all after reading the Gate 1 summary that flags it, so independent_reporters is 0. Rulings: ADOPT, unique_ptr<void, decltype(&LocalFree)> guard (same shape as the sd guard) and '-' on conversion failure. Fixed in cd97f5f3b; gate-8 re-review found the guard well-formed and built only after the success check. The pre-existing LocalFree(sddl_str) is untouched (cs-f3). The Windows leg cannot run on the review host; the rulings require a mingw syntax check plus an MSVC rig run of the final tree before any push.

trigger: an ACE whose SID sub-authority count overruns AceSize, or AceSize < 12/16 on the standard/object path (hostile SMB server or crafted NTFS volume); a->Flags is read before any size check and win_object_ace_sid_offset only checks 8 bytes after the offset
classification_rationale: the SID is handed to LookupAccountSidW/ConvertSidToStringSidW with no check that the whole SID lies inside the ACE, so a malformed ACE reads past it or renders a garbage principal as a normal ACE
summary: Derived HIGH (I3 base HIGH, E5 no change) against native MEDIUM; the derived band governs. cpp-safety F2 is the same defect on the object arm (cs-f2). Rulings: ADOPT; win_ace_sid_ok (revision 1, <=15 sub-authorities, whole SID inside the ACE) on the standard and object arms, AceSize >= 12 before Flags is read, a malformed ACE gives 'error|malformed ACE at index N' with rc 1, pure helper with boundary tests. Fixed in cd97f5f3b. Gate-8 re-review (static read): no path reads past AceSize; the length, revision and sub-authority-cap mutants all fail the new tests. The Windows leg cannot run on the review host; the rulings require a mingw syntax check plus an MSVC rig run of the final tree before any push.

trigger: unresolved
classification_rationale: nothing checks IsValidSid or GetLengthSid against AceSize - off for the object-ACE SID, and Flags is read before AceSize >= 12 is known
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I5 base MEDIUM); reporter could not isolate a trigger (candidate: a malformed security descriptor from an SMB redirector) so it stays likely and gates normally. summary: Derived HIGH from the reporter's own I3/E5 (it tabulated this as the same finding as F1; verified for the formatter, likely for the call site). The same defect was rated LOW/INFO (I8/I9) by cpp-expert F2, plugin-developer F2, architect F3, docs-writer F4 and cross-platform F7; the rulings header lists only SG F1, F2, F3 and the floor as derived HIGH, so this row is flagged for confirmation. Rulings: ADOPT; an empty principal prints '-', README documents it. Fixed in cd97f5f3b; gate-8: the mutant that drops the empty-principal '-' fails the new test.

trigger: a callback-object ACE (type 0xB or 0xC) in a DACL: the row is ace|other|-|0x00000000|-, the real SID and mask are dropped and a zero mask reads as 'no rights'
classification_rationale: README and YAML say only 'other (any other ACE type)'; the placeholder mask and principal are undocumented
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I7 base MEDIUM, E5). The reporter raised an I3 (HIGH) candidate for adjudication because the 'other' type does tell the caller the ACE was not decoded; the rulings' derived-HIGH list does not include it, so it is recorded without I3. Also raised by architect F3 (native LOW, I8). The reporter noted the placeholder behaviour pre-dates the change; provenance is recorded 'introduced' because the 'other' row is new in this diff. Rulings: ADOPT; format_win_ace takes an optional mask and prints '-' for undecoded types, README documents it. Fixed in cd97f5f3b; gate-8: the zero-mask mutant fails the new test. The Windows leg cannot run on the review host; the rulings require a mingw syntax check plus an MSVC rig run of the final tree before any push.

trigger: a directory-service principal name containing LF, if acl_to_text emits it unescaped (unverified: no such record could be created); splitting on '\n' then produces a forged well-formed ACE line (harness: a 5-field row became 10 fields)
classification_rationale: parse_acl_to_text trusts the text's line structure, so output the OS did not mean as separate entries can be shown as genuine ACEs
summary: Derived HIGH (I3 base HIGH, E5) against native MEDIUM; the derived band governs. The parser path is verified, libSystem's emission of an unescaped LF is not (kept 'likely' so it gates normally). Rulings: ADOPT as defence in depth; the kernel entry count (acl_get_entry loop) must equal the parsed count, else 'error|acl text malformed'. Fixed in cd97f5f3b. Gate-8 probed real ACLs (kernel count equalled the text-line count 3/3, 1/1, 1/1) and reasoned that a forged name always raises the line count above the kernel count; the check has no automated test (see g8-1-inline-shell-logic-uncovered).

trigger: a macOS permission or flag token containing '|' or a trailing backslash (harness: token 'x|read' gives 7 fields; a trailing backslash glues the separator, 4 fields); the principal was escaped but perms/flags were not
classification_rationale: free-text fields in the row grammar must go through row_field; two of the three on the macOS row did not
summary: Derived HIGH from the reporter's own I3/E5 (verified on the pure function); the reporter's native label was MEDIUM, nested in F2. Rulings: ADOPT; perms and flags tokens are now row_field-escaped; validating 'kind' beyond escaping was not adopted (no real input to reject). Fixed in cd97f5f3b; gate-8: the perms and flags no-escape mutants each fail the new hostile-token test.

trigger: a posix_acl xattr blob with a tag outside {1,2,4,8,0x10,0x20} (for example 0x77 or 0); only reachable when the bytes are not kernel-generated (FUSE/9p without posix_acl); a version-only blob decodes as success with zero entries
classification_rationale: the default case prints ace|other|-|rwx|-, identical to a real 'other' entry, and the old test pinned that behaviour
summary: Derived HIGH (I3 base HIGH, E5 'by formula') against native LOW; the derived band governs and the reporter asked for adjudication. Rulings: ADOPT; decode_posix_acl_xattr returns nullopt for an unknown tag and for a zero-entry blob (never partial) and the old test is inverted. Fixed in cd97f5f3b. Gate-8: a kernel ACL always carries >= 3 entries and only the six legal tags, so no genuine ACL is rejected; the tag-whitelist and size-floor mutants fail the new tests.

trigger: a file whose ACL names many user/group entries (up to ~8191 per xattr, plantable by a local user) on a host whose NSS backend (LDAP/sssd) is slow or down; each getpwuid_r/getgrgid_r call has no deadline
classification_rationale: the routed 'runtimes' row and agent-core's passwd_lookup.hpp (#3406) treat a deadline-less blocking call on a shared command worker as a defect; the new loop multiplies the wait by the entry count
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I5 base MEDIUM; no raise: needs degraded NSS and pins one worker, not the process). Also raised by security-guardian F4 (native MEDIUM, E4) and cross-platform F2 (native MEDIUM; also macOS acl_to_text and Windows LookupAccountSidW). Rulings: ADOPT the cheap half only; each distinct (tag,id) is resolved once and only the first 64 are looked up, the rest print the numeric id. Fixed in cd97f5f3b. The bounded agent-core resolver is a follow-up with no issue number in the saved artifacts; owner/group getpwuid and the macOS/Windows lookups stay unbounded (README caveat 5). Gate-8: cap and memo correct, a count bound only, no unit coverage of the cap (g8-1-inline-shell-logic-uncovered).

trigger: a macOS file carrying an ACE with an empty permission set (written via acl_set_file, e.g. by SMB-synced or third-party tools; chmod +a refuses to create one): acl_to_text emits a 5-field line and the parser requires 6
classification_rationale: get_acl regresses from a stat-only success to 'error|acl text unparseable' rc 1 on a valid ACL the OS itself printed
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I6 base MEDIUM, E5); verified by the reporter with a real file (an ACE for _www with no permissions). Rulings: ADOPT; the parser accepts the 5-field form when the last field is the verdict, fixtures and tests added. Fixed in cd97f5f3b. Gate-8 probed the real layout (empty perms prints no perms field) and the empty-perms-branch mutant fails the new test; the new test uses inline synthetic strings with no capture entry (g8-6-empty-perms-layout-no-provenance).

trigger: get_acl on a macOS path whose filesystem rejects ACL retrieval with ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP (man acl_get_file); not reproducible locally - every probed volume (FAT, exFAT, HFS+, APFS, devfs, autofs) returned ENOENT
classification_rationale: the YAML acl column (linux + darwin), README caveat 5 and capability-map section 10.7 list acl|unsupported for macOS, but the macOS leg maps only ENOENT and EACCES/EPERM and sends every other errno to error|..., dropping the stat rows the old leg returned
summary: Derived MEDIUM (I6 base MEDIUM, I7 MEDIUM). Raised by plugin-developer F1, docs-writer F3, architect F2, cpp-safety F5, security-guardian F6 and cross-platform F5; the last two showed empirically that every probed local volume returns ENOENT. independent_reporters excludes the reviewers whose brief named the suspect. Rulings: ADOPT the ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP mapping to acl|unsupported and, because ENOENT is what every probed volume returns, the docs now say macOS folds 'cannot carry' into none. Fixed in cd97f5f3b; the mapping is source-read only (gate-8 could not trigger it locally).

summary: Ruled: pre-existing line, not new, left unchanged; the manual-cleanup floor is scoped to NEW C++. The Gate 1 resource ledger already listed it as pre-existing (so independent_reporters is 0). No evidence bar beyond the one-line ruling is required at LOW.

The Linux cases were not runnable on the review host.
